title: 將身份證明文件及 IA 牌照設為必填欄位（註冊 + 報名）
content:
Make ID document number and IA license number required fields in the enrollment flow (backend Zod validation). Registration form does NOT need these as required — ID doc and IA license are not mandatory for account creation.

實作內容：
- `src/lib/validation/enroll.ts` 新增 `.refine()`：當 email 存在（guest 報名），強制 idDocNumber 和 iaLicenseNo 必填
- 已登入報名不受影響（從 DB User table 取值）
- 註冊表單不修改

風險：low
依賴：無
userStory: 註冊與報名表單必填欄位確認

findings: 新增 .refine() 於 enroll.ts:54-62: guest 時強制必填
已登入路徑 (route.ts:49-81) 從 DB User 取值，不受影響
註冊表單不需修改 (product 確認無需必填)
evidence.residual: Zod refine 僅攔截格式驗證層級，實際寫入邏輯 (guest fallback UUID) 保留不變

comments: 2026-09-18: Product confirmed — registration does NOT require ID doc/IA license. Enrollment backend Zod refine added to enforce guest required fields. CT-007 done.
acceptance: Guest 報名 API 拒收缺少 idDocNumber 或 iaLicenseNo 的請求
已登入報名不受影響（從 DB User 取值）
npm run lint 通過 (0 errors)
verification: Submit registration form with empty ID doc → error shown. Submit with empty IA license → error shown. Submit enrollment with empty IA license → error shown. All 3 locales display correct required labels.
